'''Wade Resselian''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[human]] dissident who was part of an underground movement known as [[Hidden Path|The Path]] that helped smuggle [[Jedi]] hunted by the [[Galactic Empire]] to safety. He piloted a [[T-47 airspeeder]] during a [[Rescue of Princess Leia (9 BBY)|rescue mission]] to the [[Fortress Inquisitorius]] on [[Nur]], where he was [[Death|killed]] by the [[Reva Sevander|Third Sister]]. His sacrifice, however, gave his allies enough [[time]] to escape the base and return to their headquarters on [[Jabiim]].

==Biography==
Wade Resselian joined [[Hidden Path|the Path]] sometime during the [[Proclamation of the New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. He helped the network rescue [[Jedi]] who survived [[Order 66]] and smuggle them to safety. Wade later joined a rescue mission led by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Tala Durith]] to rescue young princess [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] from the [[Fortress Inquisitorius]] on the moon Nur. Wade and [[Sully Stark]] arrived in [[T-47 airspeeder]]s to rescue Kenobi, Durith, and Organa, then distracted the [[Reva Sevander|Third Sister]]. However, Reva threw an explosive using [[the Force]] at his airspeeder which caused it to explode, [[Death|killing]] him.<ref name="Kenobi IV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wade Resselian was portrayed by actor [[Ryder McLaughlin]].<ref name="Kenobi IV" />
